0.0: Ah, this place brings back memories. Look at all that dust! I used to clean that! \r\n#L0##bDo these robots look new to you?#l\n#k
0.1: I sure don't know any of them. I think #p2154009# knew you'd come back. \r\n#L0##bWhat a warm welcome.#l\n#k
0.2: They should be no match for you, but they're going to hinder our investigation. Take out #b100#k #b#o9300645##k robots!

yes.0: I know we're here to get your memories back, but this is really drudging up some nasty times for me. Let's get moving, okay?

no.0: What's the matter? Don't get all nostalgic on me.

1.0: Those robots are still around, but I guess we can move forward.

yes.0: I see nothing but guard robots here. It's a little eerie...
